thread:
Jamie: Heads-up — planning a blue->green pinwave for the router tonight 23:00 UTC. Goal: pin model v3.2.1, warm KV/prefix cache, then phased traffic shift 1% -> 10% -> 50% -> 100%. Can @Liam @Sara help run checks? Rollback window 20m.

devops-bot: deploy-bot: window reserved 23:00-01:00 UTC. Dry-run validated. Command template: `deployctl pin router --model v3.2.1 --cohort canary=1`

Liam: I got it. I'll kick the warmup script and monitor p95/p99. pinging oncall-kyla for rollback watch.

Sara: I'll monitor error budget + logs. Prepared fallback model: v3.1.8-quant (preloaded).

devops-bot: DRY-RUN OK: route config validated; no capacity conflicts detected. Expected warmup traffic: ~1k requests/min.

Jamie: Rules of engagement: pause 5m between ramps. Continue only if p95 <= 250ms and error-rate delta < 0.5%. Rollback triggers: error bump > 1% absolute OR p95 increase > 150ms from baseline.

oncall-kyla: Oncall acked. I'll stage rollback command in my clipboard: `deployctl unpin router --model v3.1.8` and pre-arm CB: `routerctl set-circuit-breaker --factor 1.5`. I'll watch SLOs and traces.

Sara: Also remember KV prefix warming call: `curl -X POST https://internal-warmup/api -d '{"prefix":"v3.2.1","samples":1000}'` — I already queued it.

Liam: Starting warmup now. ETA ~3m. Logs: `warmup: queued=1000 warmed=240/1000`

devops-bot: Note: add pin metadata to release notes: "pin: router=v3.2.1; warmup: true; rollback_criteria: error+latency". Release page: https://releases.internal/6789

Jamie: :thumbsup: launching canary in ~30s.

(devops-bot system): deployctl apply --dry-run 
CONFIG OK: cohorts: canary=1% -> weightmap validated

Liam: Canary live at 1%. Observing metrics...

Jamie: Quick checks: p95=210ms, error-rate +0.1% -> OK to proceed to 10% hold.

Liam: Moving to 10% now. Pausing 5m after step.

oncall-kyla: Traces look clean, no new 5xx spikes. I'm watching p99 and request failures by host.

Sara: Seeing small p99 bump to 820ms on a single host (host-az3-12). Investigating logs — repeated JS V8 GC stall entries.

Liam: Tagging host-az3-12 for drain and moving traffic off. `routerctl drain host-az3-12`

Jamie: Hold on further ramps until host drains. If we see another host replicate the same tail behavior, we rollback.

Sara: Drain complete on host-az3-12. p99 back to 430ms cluster-wide. No new errors.

Liam: Resuming ramp: 50% now.

devops-bot: telemetry check: p95 delta=+30ms, error-rate delta=+0.2% — within thresholds.

Jamie: Proceed to 100% but keep 15m watch window. If any host shows p99 > 1s or error bump >1% trigger rollback.

oncall-kyla: Copy that. Rollback command staged and ready.

Sara: Updating release notes with the warmup and drain incident: "note: host drain due to GC tail on host-az3-12; mitigated; continued rollout."

Liam: 100% completed. Observability: p95=225ms, p99=440ms, errors +0.25%. All good so far.

Jamie: Great job team. Leaving the pin in place for 6h per policy then we'll evaluate canary logs and decide whether to unpin. Closing thread when release notes + post-mortem snippet are added. :party_parrot:
